explanation: Multiply, don't add: 256 levels of red times 256 of green times 256 of blue gives about 16.8 million colours. Mixing red and green light at full strength makes yellow.

claims.text: With 256 levels each for red, green and blue, a pixel can show 256 x 256 x 256 = 16,777,216 colours.
768 is 256 + 256 + 256, 65,536 is 256 x 256 and 4,294,967,296 is 256 to the power 4, so none counts the combinations of three channels.
